## Tutorials

The DEGREES() function converts a value in radians to degrees.

Note:See also theRADIANS()andPI()functions.

### Code Examples

```
SELECT DEGREES(1.5);

---

DEGREES(
number
)

---

SELECT DEGREES(PI()*2);
```

## Tutorials

The DIV function is used for integer division (x is divided by y). An integer value is 
returned.

### Code Examples

```
SELECT 10 DIV 5;

---

x
DIV
y

---

SELECT 8 DIV 3;
```

## Tutorials

The EXP() function returnseraised to the power of the specified 
number.

The constante(2.718281...), is the base of natural logarithms.

Tip:Also look at theLOG()andLN()functions.

### Code Examples

```
SELECT EXP(1);

---

EXP(
number
)

---

SELECT EXP(2);
```

## Tutorials

The FLOOR() function returns the largest integer value that is smaller than 
or equal to a number.

Note:Also look at theROUND(),CEIL(),CEILING(),TRUNCATE(), andDIVfunctions.

### Code Examples

```
SELECT FLOOR(25.75);

---

FLOOR(
number
)

---

SELECT FLOOR(25);
```

## Tutorials

The GREATEST() function returns the greatest value of the list of arguments.

Note:See also theLEAST()function.

### Code Examples

```
SELECT GREATEST(3, 12, 34, 8, 25);

---

GREATEST(
arg1
,
arg2
,
arg3
, ...)

---

SELECT GREATEST("w3Schools.com", "microsoft.com", "apple.com");
```
